title: RAG Implementation in .NET
description: Implement retrieval-augmented generation pipelines in C# using popular libraries and real data sources.
longDescription: This module covers the full RAG pipeline: chunking documents, generating embeddings, storing vectors, retrieving relevant context, and composing prompts for LLMs. You will implement these steps using Microsoft.Extensions.AI, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex.TS/.NET patterns, and Azure AI Search.
whatYouLearn: Design a RAG pipeline from raw documents to grounded LLM answers
Choose chunking strategies and embedding models for different data types
Persist and query vectors using common .NET-backed stores
Implement retrieval with filtering, hybrid search, and reranking
Compose prompts safely and avoid common RAG failure modes
Use Azure.AI.Search v1 and Azure.AI.Inference for Azure-native RAG
Run local models with Ollama and Microsoft.Extensions.AI
